issue.title: 'Email alerts' toggle resets to on after leaving Settings
issue.body:
## Summary
Toggling 'Email alerts' off does not persist after leaving and reopening Settings.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Open Settings > Notifications.
2. Toggle 'Email alerts' off.
3. Go back.
4. Reopen Settings.

## Expected Behavior
The 'Email alerts' toggle should stay off.

## Actual Behavior
The toggle is on again.

## Environment
- App version: v2.4.1
- OS: Android 14
- Device: Pixel 8

## Additional Notes
The issue happens every time.

issue.title: Email alerts toggle resets to on after leaving Settings
issue.body:
